blocks.h2: Sewage in the Basement? Start Here

steps.body: No flushing, showers, dishwasher or laundry. It all goes to the same line.
Keep children and pets away from the water.
Don't step in water near outlets, extension cords or appliances.
Let us know which drain the water is coming from.

tiles.h3: A Clog in a Sagging Line
tiles.body: Paper and wipes pile up in a low spot until nothing gets through.
Storms fill the sewers and push water to the lowest drain in the house.
In a basement bathroom, a dead pump means the basin overflows.
A root mat can stop the line overnight.

blocks.intro: In August 2025, the National Weather Service reported significant flash flooding in Mokena.

items.body: Many Mokena homes have finished lower levels with carpet, drywall and a bathroom. A backup there is costly.
If the alarm doesn't work, the first sign can be water on the floor.
A clean line, a backflow valve and an [overhead sewer system](/mokena/overhead-sewer-systems) each solve part of the problem.

steps.body: We camera the line and walk you through the video.
Flat rate, approved before we start.

blocks.h2: Sewer Backup Questions From Mokena Homeowners

items.q: Why does sewage come up through the floor drain when it rains hard?
items.preview: Either your line or the village sewer is overwhelmed.
items.answer: Either your own line is partly blocked, or the public sewer filled up and pushed back into the lowest drain in your house. Our camera can tell which one it is.

items.q: Could my ejector pump be the reason for the backup?
items.answer: If the backup is in a basement bathroom, yes. A dead pump lets the basin overflow. We repair and replace [ejector pumps](/mokena/ejector-pump).

items.q: Does homeowners insurance pay for sewer backups?
items.preview: Usually only with a sewer backup rider.
items.answer: Usually only if you have a sewer backup rider on your policy. It's worth asking your agent before the next storm.

items.q: What can I do so this doesn't happen again?
items.preview: Keep the line clean and protect the basement.
items.answer: Keep the line clean with scheduled [sewer maintenance](/mokena/sewer-maintenance), and if storms are the trigger, add a backflow valve or an overhead sewer.

items.q: What does sewer backup service cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on the cause. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what caused the backup and how we get to the line. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we begin.
